metadata.title: Bengal Gram Chutney | Assamese Recipe
metadata.description:
A simple, rustic yet flavourful recipe that goes on amazingly well as a side to your meals. 

Ingredients Required

Bengal gram - 1/4 cup
Green Chilies - 4-5
Ginger - 1 inch piece
Garlic - 6- cloves
Coriander leaves
Mustard Oil - 1 tablespoon
Salt as required
